Flavor text sources for the /itscoming line. Of course, it's from nine different cards.

the worst part between what you see and what actually is, the only truth now. You shall not feel my bones The protection of the most awful future Indeed...You are not real.

  1. Enclave of the Endlings - Gruum - "Gruum was very strong, yes. And Gruum was tough as well. La Capitan's crew couldn't even slow its charge. But the worst part was the constant yelling."
  2. Miss Information (VotM) - Endless Possibilities - "There are worlds of difference between what you see and what actually is, Maia"
  3. Realm of Discord – Negative Energy Field – “Everything burned. Moving hurt, but staying in one place was worse. No matter what happened, one thing was clear: pain was the only truth now.”
  4. Nightmist – Oblivion - "You shall not enter this world!"-Nightmist, Nightmist #22
  5. La Capitan – Chronological Hotspot – “Augh! This pain I can feel my bones tearing me apart!"
  6. The Naturalist – Indomitable Force – "The protection of innocence is the purest venture." The Naturalist, Cosmic Concurrence #7
  7. The Visionary – Demoralization – "Visions of the most awful future can be rather disheartening." -The Visionary, Mind Over Matter #43
  8. Apostate – Apocalypse - "Indeed…perish you shall!" -Apostate, Absolution #19
  9. Infinitor – Lambent Reaper - "You are not real. You can still hurt me. This is not what I wanted today." -Sky-Scraper, Cosmic Concurrence #23

wait…can someone explain how they put the semi-whatchyacallits into the cipher? 

 

Reading from 1 to 9, the semaphore letters were OLSDALEDI.  How a railfence cipher is that you read the encrypted text by row from top to bottom, filling in so that you move up and down the rows.  If you use 3 levels it looks like this:

O        L        S

   D   A   L   E

     D         I

 

You then read from left to right going up and down the fence as needed and it reads ODDALLIES.

Tindiyen suggests that maybe we need to find " the worst part between what you see and what actually is, the only truth now. You shall not feel my bones The protection of the most awful future Indeed...You are not real." in flavor text. grysqrl finds most of the quotes that match, Chogb puts those cards together to spell 'Genocidal': http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.greaterthangames.com/genocidal

DocBrown puts the barcode from the Genocidal comic in the magic place: http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.greaterthangames.com/982354617

The Mega Computer stuff in this was actually discovered a while ago by Kratos13; anyway, so an image (https://www.dropbox.com/s/sh5ld7n7fmgm1u0/intervene.PNG?dl=0) can be found in the Steam game by playing three Mega Computers in Megalopolis. VisForYoshi spots that the left-most letters in the first paragraph spell out base eight. Eventually, brettwo thought to knock the 9 off the barcode and convert the result into octal:  http://sentinelsofthemultiverse.greaterthangames.com/421234220

I'm going to bed.

So, I've done a little digging on the Ambuscade info on BoardGameGeek, and noticed that the bio on the image for his mini-pack bio card doesn't match up with his official bio. I'll show what I've found different by Bolding the text in the Bios

-----------------------------------------------------

From the main Sentinels of the Multiverse website's bio on Ambuscade: Ansel G. Moreau, world-famous French action movie star, has a few dark secrets. His hobby of big game hunting has spiraled out of control - his constant need for bigger and more threatening prey has him hunting the very heroes that protect the earth! To this end, he employed a shady genetics corporation to give him superpowers, but the process went terribly wrong, scarring his million-dollar face and ending his acting career.

However, he did gain some new, energy-manipulation abilities from the process, which he plans to put to good use. Taking the name Ambuscade, he employs his new powers and a vast arsenal to hunt the heroes he considers to be the most dangerous and powerful. More musing on us needing to pay attention to what the Scion said. Here's every word spoken by the Scion:

It's about time.
I see you are not quite as dense as you seem, little heroes of earth.
Like those you have battled before me and continue to fight now, I am but a scion of the cosmic entity who now seeks to destroy all.
It found me beyond space and time and offered me a collar.
Of course, I fought it.
But its power was far too great.
I learned three things.
I'm glad you asked, Mr. Riske.
First, that it could be damaged.
Second, that it had vast untold power.
And lastly, that it wanted to destroy everything.
And that it had such a goal gave me everything I needed.
You will fight it.
Use what I have told you.
Eventually, it will call me to fight you.
But I know how tenacious and resourceful you can be.
I will be there when you weaken it, and I will have its power for my own.
Because, sweet child, I do not want to destroy everything, so me with this power is a far better outcome than you can hope for.
You cannot defeat it without me, and it will exterminate all reality if left unopposed.
You know what you must do.
